RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: route home
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: The way back. Set these along the path you came in by, at every junction where the way out is not obvious.\n\nA route marker left at a junction, and still where you put it, is what lets a crew tell the difference between a corridor that has changed and a corridor they misremembered.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: cleared
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: Searched, and nothing left in it worth coming back for. Green means you have already spent time here.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: danger
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: Something happened here, or something is still here. Red is the one colour a crew should be able to read at the far end of a corridor.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: supply cache
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: Something worth carrying out is here, and nobody has carried it yet. Useful when a crew finds more than it can lift in one trip.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: unexplored lead
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: A way on that nobody has taken yet. The marker is for the next crew as much as this one.
